-- REQ: LANG-1151 LANG-1152
local record Point
   x: number
   y: number
end

local enum Color
   "red"
   "green"
end

global function greet(name: string, times: integer): string
   local text = "Hello, " .. name .. "!\n"
   local result = ""
   for i = 1, times do
      result = result .. text
   end
   return result
end

local p: Point = { x = 1.5, y = 2 }
local c: Color = "red"
print(greet("teal", 2), p.x, c as string, nil)
